meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: "Manage Line Items": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing
gaps: Compare the saved draft's status, schedule times, vendors, and bids before and after Cancel to prove each is unchanged.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Compare the saved draft's status, schedule times, vendors, and bids before and after Cancel to prove each is unchanged.

steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow.
Provide the required draft title.
Apply a template so line items can be managed.
Create the one line item referenced by the test.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Give the draft a committed schedule so it has saved event data.
Give the draft a participant as part of its saved state.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft under test.
Confirm saving the draft did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to open the saved draft.
Show saved drafts.
Confirm this plan's saved draft appears in Drafts.
Verify the saved event is still a Draft before opening it.
Reopen this plan's saved draft on its create screen.
Record the expected one-line-item state before opening Manage Line Items.
Open the Manage Line Items window.
Confirm the required management window opened.
Cancel without making any line-item changes.
Assert that Cancel closes the Manage Line Items window.
Assert that the event still has the original single line item after cancellation.
